key.name: show-on-hover
key.description: Show the panel when the mouse cursor approaches the top edge of the screen.

key.name: show-in-overview
key.description: Show the panel when the Activities Overview is open.

key.name: intellihide
key.description: Only hide the panel when a window takes up the space at the top of the screen.

key.name: show-in-empty-workspace
key.summary: Show top bar in empty workspace
key.description: Always show the top bar when there are no windows on the current workspace.

key.name: intellihide-strict
key.summary: Only hide when window covers top bar
key.description: Only hide the panel when a window is physically overlapping the top bar area, rather than hiding whenever any window is maximized.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration of the panel slide animation in milliseconds.

key.name: hover-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before hiding the panel after the pointer leaves it.

key.name: pressure-threshold
key.description: Pointer pressure required at the top edge to reveal the panel. Set to 0 for instant hover.

key.name: toggle-panel-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to temporarily toggle panel visibility (e.g. <Super><Alt>p).
